{"path":"todo_anthropic-claude-sonnet-5_01.html","edit_description":"Create a complete, self-contained single-file Todo app (HTML+CSS+JS all inline, no external dependencies).

Requirements:
- Clean modern UI, centered card layout, gradient background, responsive for mobile.
- Header with title "Todo App" and an input form to add new todos (text input + "Add" button, submit on Enter).
- Each todo item shows: a checkbox to toggle completion (adds strikethrough + faded style to text when completed), the todo text, and a delete button (e.g. "×" icon) that removes it.
- Filter tabs/buttons: "All", "Active", "Completed" — clicking filters the visible list accordingly, with the active filter visually highlighted.
- A footer area showing count of remaining active (not completed) todos, and a "Clear completed" button that removes all completed todos.
- Persistence: all todos (id, text, completed) saved to localStorage under a key like "todos-claude-app", loaded on page load, and saved again after every add/toggle/delete/clear action.
- Empty state message when there are no todos to show for the current filter (e.g. "No todos yet" / "Nothing here").
- All code inline in one HTML file: <style> in <head>, JS in <script> before </body>. No external libraries or CDN links.
- Use vanilla JavaScript (no frameworks), semantic HTML, and accessible markup (labels, aria attributes where reasonable).
- Generate unique ids for todos using Date.now() + random suffix or similar.
- Escape/sanitize todo text when rendering to avoid HTML injection (use textContent or proper escaping)."}
